item.description: Thursday was a hot and sunny day in the Valley. Temperatures soared nearly ten degrees compared to yesterday’s high, reaching 92 degrees in the Valley. This was near-record heat today for Phoenix, but the area is set to break record-highs on Friday. The Valley will cool into the low 60s through Friday morning, and climb to 93 degrees Friday afternoon.
